vocab.description: First release: 5000 German words ordered by level and frequency

changes: Phone layout: on a narrow screen the menu slides in with the ☰ button and closes with ✕, a tap outside or by choosing a page
Phone layout: bigger buttons, the dictionary shows each word as a card, the app can be added to the home screen (icon: the German flag)
Update Progress page: note that progress is saved per device and is not shared between phone and computer
German nouns can be typed with their article (das Haus); a wrong article counts as a mistake
New setting on the Update Progress page: require the article when typing a German noun
Fixed labels that still said FR (sidebar, dictionary table and search)
Removed the flag in front of the app name
After a wrong answer the correct German noun is always shown with its article (die Ordnung)
The hint about a missing German voice disappears when the browser finds a German voice
